extracted.intended_audience: authors and peer reviewers submitting to Nature and related Nature Research journals
extracted.subtask_description: Policy and procedural guidance for Nature's transparent peer review scheme governing publication of reviewer reports and author rebuttals for original research submissions and related matters (consent, redaction, scope, and limitations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of published peer review file
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication of a peer review file containing the reviewer comments to the authors and the author rebuttal letters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For all original research papers published in Nature authors can agree to the publication of a peer review file containing the reviewer comments to the authors and the author rebuttal letters. The peer review file will contain the full reviewer reports to authors and the author rebuttal letters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author opt-in / opt-out
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are given the opportunity to opt out of the transparent peer review scheme at the point of acceptance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors will be asked if they would like to opt in/out at the point of acceptance. Transparent peer review will be offered to authors of newly submitted original research papers submitted on or after 1st February 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility / scope of rollout
rubrics_metrics.description: Which submissions are eligible for transparent peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offered for original research papers submitted to Nature on or after 1 February 2020. A similar initiative is offered to authors of new submissions to Nature Biomedical Engineering, Nature Cell Biology, Nature Ecology & Evolution, Nature Human Behaviour, Nature Immunology, Nature Microbiology, Nature Structural & Molecular Biology and Nature Communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer consent and opt-out
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer reviewers are informed about the initiative when invited and may decline to review if uncomfortable with publication of their report; accepting to review is regarded as permission to release the reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Peer reviewers can decline to review the manuscript if they are not comfortable with their review being published. Acceptance to review is regarded as permission to release the reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer anonymity / naming
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer names are not published unless the reviewer signs their comments; reviewers may request their name be added up to acceptance notification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unless reviewers sign the comments to the authors with their name, Nature will respect and maintain their full anonymity under all circumstances. Reviewers can request that their name be added to their comments at any point, up to and including receipt of a notification that the manuscript has been accepted in principle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of transferred manuscripts and prior reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer reports transferred between Nature Research journals will not automatically be included in the peer review file if they were submitted without consent to publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a manuscript is transferred from one Nature Research journal to another, reviewer reports are transferred as well. However, these reports and the author responses to them will not be included in the peer review file as they may have been submitted without consent to potential publication. If the same reviewers subsequently agree to review for the recipient journal offering transparent peer review, only their reviewer reports for the recipient journal will be included. Instances of transferred manuscripts that were previously peer reviewed will be marked up in the peer review file, without naming the other journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing and redaction policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer review files are not edited except to redact confidential information or third-party material; authors can suggest redactions; all redactions will be noted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The peer review file will not be edited except to redact confidential information or third party material. Authors will be able to suggest redaction of such material for the editor to review. All redactions when made will be noted in the peer review file, including any requested by the author and agreed by the editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial discretion to withhold reports
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal reserves the right not to publish peer review reports in special cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal also reserves the right not to publish peer review reports in special cases, for example, where reports contain a lot of confidential clinical information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitations of what the peer review file shows
rubrics_metrics.description: Published peer review files provide insight into reviewer recommendations but do not capture confidential communications or the full complexity of editorial decision-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The richness and complexity of editorial debate and decisions will not be apparent as correspondence between authors and editors, reviewer comments made confidentially to editors, and internal discussions between editors will remain confidential. A paper might be published against the advice of a reviewer if, for example, confidential feedback from other reviewers favours publication overall. These discussions might not always be fully captured in the peer review file, although Nature may add editorial explanations to some of the files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial decision letters not published
rubrics_metrics.description: Nature will not publish the editorial decision letters as part of the peer review file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit policy statement: No, Nature will not publish the editorial decision letters as part of the peer review file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring and reporting of opt-in rates and feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal monitors author opt-in rates and feedback from stakeholders and reports these metrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nature monitors parameters such as author opt-in rates and feedback from authors, reviewers and readers, and has reported these for Nature Communications to the community in an editorial.
